_comment: sim-preplace-branch-select-bounded-v1: move the collect pre-place reaction-branch standoff SELECTION off the host hot path and make it cheap + time-boxed, and make the host status heartbeat structurally independent of any planning. Captain's rule UNCHANGED: the box stays parallel to the ground, 2.0 deg bound / 0.15 s grace, NEVER loosened. This lane changes NOTHING about the chosen branch, the leg plans, the gate, the caps, the guards or any PR 340-345 behaviour -- the selection RESULT is byte-identical to coldwin57's inline computation (asserted on the coldwin57 fixture); it only stops the selection from blocking /manipulation/status. Builds directly on docs/examples/preplace-wrist-continuity-fragment.json (PR 345); keep that fragment's keys and add the two below.

_root_cause.coldwin59_real_hang: coldwin59 (reaction_branch ON, hot-path DRIVE_TICK logging OFF) died on HOST_STATUS_WATCHDOG site=isaac_ros_graph.poll clock=sim sim_gap=5.02s bound=5.00s, with ZERO PREPLACE_LEVEL_GATE / PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH / CARTON_LEVEL_PREPLACE_GATE lines -- the reaction-branch solve NEVER completed. coldwin58 was the SAME hang (the DRIVE_TICK hypothesis is disproven). Isaac / station / nvblox stayed ALIVE through the gap (STATION_STATS advancing, ESDF requests succeeding): ONLY the manipulation controller hung.
_root_cause.mechanism: select_reaction_natural_standoff ran SYNCHRONOUSLY inside controller.step() at the preplace transition and ran the full densified leg-2 plan_level_world_approach for ALL enumerated branches = ~14 s on the coldwin57 fixture (8 branches x ~1.7 s; continuous_level_solve is FK-heavy). The host publishes /manipulation/status only from its single rclpy executor thread (RosTransferBridge._emit per /sensors tick, and .heartbeat inside payload waits), so a >5 s synchronous solve on that thread starves the heartbeat and the Isaac 5 sim-s watchdog kills a live host. A plain watchdog-bound raise is NOT the fix -- a >5 s solve at every preplace is itself the problem.
_root_cause.cpu_measurement: time.perf_counter on the coldwin57 fixture URDF: old full-plan selection 13.9-14.2 s; the new cheap selection 0.085 s (same chosen standoff, byte-identical to 1e-12 on all six joints). Enumerate alone is 0.05 s; the cost was entirely the per-branch densified plan.

_mechanism.1_cheap_byte_identical_selection: carton_level.select_reaction_natural_standoff now defaults to full_plan=False: it validates each branch's leg-2 feasibility at the CHEAP leg-2-start endpoint (level_config at the carry pan; the standoff end is already reach+level from enumerate) and reports the holding torque over the 2-point [leg-2 start, standoff] sweep, instead of the full densified plan_level_world_approach per branch. The CHOSEN standoff is decided by the min-|wrist_2| PRIMARY key -- which the per-branch plan never affected (it only filtered + ranked) -- and the returned value is the enumerate branch config verbatim either way, so the result is byte-identical to the old inline computation on the coldwin57 fixture. A mid-leg-2 infeasibility the full plan alone would have caught is still owned by the downstream world-level approach gate (_issue_gated_preplace_approach re-plans + rejects before motion). full_plan=True restores the old per-branch densified path (the parity reference the identity test compares against).
_mechanism.2_cpu_time_box_refuses_before_motion: select_reaction_natural_standoff takes budget_s (CPU clock, time.perf_counter -- the search is pure CPU, NOT a sim event) and raises carton_level.BranchSelectBudgetExceeded if the search runs past it. controller._preplace_above_place_goal passes carton_level.preplace_branch_select_budget_s and, on the budget exception, REFUSES the preplace before motion (PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH_REFUSED -> named _fail) instead of silently degrading or blocking the heartbeat. The default budget 2.0 s is >20x the measured 0.085 s and a fraction of the 5 s watchdog; the search never approaches it on the fixture.
_mechanism.3_heartbeat_structurally_independent: restock_manipulation.status_heartbeat.StatusHeartbeat is a SEPARATE daemon thread wired in ros_host.py that publishes the SAME liveness /manipulation/status message RosTransferBridge already emits (status='running', heartbeat=True, no controls -> never clears active) whenever the last publish is older than the interval AND a job is active. It uses RosTransferBridge._publish_liveness, which does NOT advance the sensor-stream anchors, so the sensor watchdog is untouched. This guarantees no planning that blocks the executor can EVER starve the status heartbeat again (the belt-and-suspenders beyond the cheap selector). Sequence allocation + publish are lock-guarded so the executor thread and the filler thread never collide on a sequence number.
_mechanism.4_logged_once: PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH now also logs select=<s> (the measured CPU search time) + the budget + 'cheap|full path, off the host hot path', so a console grep proves the selection stayed off the hot path (select_seconds << 5 s). CONFIG_PREFLIGHT PREPLACE_WRIST_CONTINUITY reports the budget. STATUS_HEARTBEAT logs the filler thread start + interval at host boot.

host_config._file: scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json (resolved by ros_host.py -> TransferController). Keep EVERY coldwin57/coldwin58 key from preplace-wrist-continuity-fragment.json (preplace_wrist_first, preplace_convergence_stall_s, carry_lift_shape, collect_place_preplace_shape, station_pitch_hold + mirrors, preplace_budget_margin_s, and the whole carton_level block incl preplace_level_gate + preplace_reaction_branch). This lane ADDS exactly the two keys below.
host_config._status_heartbeat_note: TOP-LEVEL HOST key (read by ros_host.py, NOT nested under carton_level). Seconds; the max intended gap between /manipulation/status publishes while a job is active -- the StatusHeartbeat filler tops up any larger gap. 0.5 s => worst-case gap ~0.6 s, well under the 5 s Isaac watchdog. Set 0 to disable the filler thread (byte-identical, no gap-fill -- only do this to reproduce the old no-filler behaviour).

carton_level._keep_all_coldwin57_keys: preplace_level_gate:true, preplace_reaction_branch:true, preplace_max_wrist_step_rad:0.15, preplace_soft_effort_nm:56.0, preplace_max_segment_rad:0.08, preplace_approach_speed:0.05, preplace_approach_accel:0.05, preplace_above_support:true, preplace_support_clearance_m:0.08, place_from_above:true, place_above_clearance_m:0.08, place_contact_release:true, place_contact_gap_m:0.012, gravity_compensation{stiffness_nm_per_rad:2850,carton_mass_kg:0.45} -- ALL UNCHANGED from PR 345.
carton_level._budget_note: NESTED under carton_level (resolved by carton_level.resolve_level_config into LevelConfig). The CPU time-box (seconds) for the reaction-branch standoff search. Default 2.0; the measured cost is ~0.085 s, so this is a safety net -- a search that somehow runs past it REFUSES the preplace before motion (PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH_REFUSED) rather than blocking the heartbeat. Do NOT raise it toward 5 s: the budget is a fail-fast floor, not the watchdog.

runtime_config._file: mission-runtime-*.json (EXTERNAL to the repo; the integration lane owns it). UNCHANGED from coldwin57/coldwin58 -- this lane adds NO runtime keys. (Both new keys are HOST keys; status_heartbeat_interval_s is top-level host, preplace_branch_select_budget_s is nested in the host carton_level block. A key in the wrong file/block is silently inactive -- verify with the boot logs below.)

activation_checks.host_boot: CONFIG_PREFLIGHT PREPLACE_WRIST_CONTINUITY ... branch-select CPU budget=2.0 s off the host hot path; and STATUS_HEARTBEAT filler thread started (interval=0.50 s).
activation_checks.at_preplace: PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH chosen wrist_2=~0.32 ... select=<0.2 s (budget 2.0 s, cheap path, off the host hot path -- coldwin59).

acceptance_coldwin60.no_watchdog: NO HOST_STATUS_WATCHDOG anywhere in the run (the selection no longer blocks the executor; the filler keeps /manipulation/status fresh).
acceptance_coldwin60.selection_logged_once_within_budget: exactly one PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH line at the preplace entry with select=<budget (well under 1 s), chosen wrist_2 ~0.32 (NOT 1.63).
acceptance_coldwin60.both_legs_converge: wrist-first leg 1 + leg 2 both converge within the derived phase budget; no phase timeout, no CARTON_LEVEL_PLAN_REJECTED, no PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH_REFUSED.
acceptance_coldwin60.carton_level: CARTON_TICK world tilt peak <= 1.5 deg over both legs; no CARTON_TILT trip (the 2.0 deg / 0.15 s rule holds, never loosened).
acceptance_coldwin60.no_tracking_fault: no TRAJ_HOST_TRACK_MISS / EXEC_ABORT on the carried preplace (PR 345's wrist fix now actually gets exercised -- it was never reached before).
acceptance_coldwin60.place: the full D6 base lock engages at place start, the weld releases at true shelf contact (PLACE_CONTACT_RELEASE), verify_place passes, and the run ADVANCES PAST collect.
acceptance_coldwin60.note: coldwin60 is the GPU proof and belongs to the integration lane (this lane never takes /tmp/aile-gpu.lock). It is the FIRST run where PR 345's untested wrist fix and PR 339's full D6 lock actually execute, because every prior reaction_branch run died at the preplace transition before the gate fired.

cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_preplace_branch_select_bounded_v1.py: fast selection byte-identical to full_plan on the coldwin57 fixture; selection < 1 s (cheap); budget overrun raises BranchSelectBudgetExceeded (refusal); StatusHeartbeat keeps the heartbeat gap <= 1 s under a 10 s blocking mock planner; the >5 s gap reproduced on the old no-filler path; idle silence + note_publish suppression + arg validation.
